entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Keys using properties on complex types are not stored correctly in the model snapshot #39649
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • Cast all projected date/time and Guid constants #39659
    community-contribution
  • Validate the Cosmos session token management mode #39658
    community-contribution
  • Reject negative timeouts in Microsoft.Data.Sqlite #39657
    community-contribution
  • Throw ObjectDisposedException from SqliteBlob.Write(ReadOnlySpan<byte>) #39656
    community-contribution
  • Don't turn a sub-second TimeSpan command timeout into no timeout #39655
    community-contribution
  • Validate enum values parsed from strings in SqliteConnectionStringBuilder #39654
    community-contribution
  • Fix MinBy/MaxBy null-key handling with index-friendly selection #39653
    community-contribution
  • Don't treat a filtered index as covering a foreign key index #39652
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39651
  • Preserve complex property paths in snapshot keys #39650

Merged

  • Use SqlClient 8 preview #39584
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39543
  • Materialize a right/full-joined outer non-entity projection as null on no-match (#30915) #39556
    community-contribution

Updated

  • [release/11.0] Preserve generated values when replacing entries #39629
  • Translate a not-null predicate on Count/LongCount over a grouping to COUNT(x) #39503
    community-contribution
  • Support null versus empty for owned JSON collections #39630
    community-contribution
  • Don't serve a temporal query from a cached plain query of the same shape #39590
    community-contribution
  • Translate Enumerable.Concat over byte arrays on SQL Server and SQLite #39578
    community-contribution
  • Don't scaffold a foreign key as one-to-one when its unique index is filtered #39574
    community-contribution
  • Don't leave the context in a bad state when tracking an entity fails #39614
    community-contribution, area-harness
  • Release completed migration instances #39520
    community-contribution
  • Discover the migrations-bundle DbContext out-of-process so publish doesn't lock the assembly #38456
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Add an EFMigrationsOutputDir project property as the default --output-dir #39568
    community-contribution
  • Let migrations remove find the migration files via --output-dir #39567
    community-contribution
  • Place the model snapshot in --output-dir when it is specified #39565
    community-contribution
  • Always use LF line endings in scaffolded code #39601
    community-contribution
  • Scaffold foreign keys whose column type differs from the principal key #39633
    community-contribution
  • Translate primitive collections projected through set operations #39561
    community-contribution
  • Fix final GroupBy over queries with no identifier #39586
    community-contribution
  • Make service provider context discovery best-effort in the tools #39562
    community-contribution
  • Throw when same-named DbParameters are hard-coded in FromSql/SqlQuery SQL #39593
    community-contribution
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: Don't retry SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT #39587
    community-contribution
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: Include extended error code and guidance in SqliteException messages #39588
    community-contribution
  • Throw for proxy navigations whose accessors cannot be overridden #39591
    community-contribution
  • Throw for change-tracking proxy properties whose setters cannot be overridden #39592
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39645
  • Support complex properties on owned types #39522
    community-contribution
